content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I've encountered an issue with [product_name] V8.0. While working in FBD mode, the Mathematic instruction block doesn't allow reference parameters—the 'Reference' buttons are missing. However, when using LAD mode, these buttons are present. Is there a workaround or update available for this issue?
The [article_no] version has some new features. Please check the attached image; it may help resolve your problem.
Thank you, this helps. I hope this issue will be addressed in a future version.
This isn't a bug; it's an intentional design decision.
I disagree. This option works in LAD mode, but not in FBD mode. It seems like the functionality was unintentionally omitted in the FBD view.

analysis.insight_summary: Users notice inconsistent feature availability in [product_name] V8 between FBD and LAD programming modes. The absence of the 'Reference' button in the Mathematic instruction block within FBD mode is seen as either a bug or an oversight, causing confusion regarding expected functionality and consistency across programming environments.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the 'Reference' function to be present in the Mathematic instruction block for both FBD and LAD modes, aiming for consistent feature access regardless of programming method.
